extracted.name: Mexican Rice with Bell Pepper
extracted.description: This Mexican rice with bell peppers (not to be confused with Spanish rice) is excellent. I make it as a side to serve with all of my Mexican dishes.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add rice; cook and stir for 3 minutes. Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.

Stir in tomato, onion, bell pepper, and jalapeño. Add cilantro, bouillon, garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer until rice is tender and all liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes.
